Network data used independently of CIC

sources.scope: Model mechanism, not evidence of IDS accuracy or low-cost updating in this experiment

measurements.quality: Final model on entire fixed test
measurements.new_attack_mean: Arithmetic mean of post-initial class F1 from full-test confusion matrix
measurements.retention: Final minus initial Macro-F1 on the same initial-class panel; distinct from full-test metrics
measurements.update_cost: Sum after initial stage; selection/eviction/construction/fit/cache; excludes all inference
measurements.composition_example: Actual seed 43 rows; not a seed-averaged composition

limitations: Three seeds on a fixed, previously inspected train/test split
Row IDs disjoint; identical feature vectors can remain
Cost excludes initial preparation and all inference; XGB buffers measured in a separate session on the same hardware
Retention panel differs from full test; no guarantee for all old classes
Architecture and charts are embedded images; other slide text/diagrams editable
